entities.name: N-sulfonylation of N-H heteroarene
observations: 3,5-Dimethoxybenzenesulfonyl chloride reacts with an N-H pyrrole/azole-like heteroarene to form an N-sulfonyl heteroarene by substitution of chloride.
The transformation forms an N-S bond and is not an acylation, alkylation, cyclization, or Pd/Cu-mediated coupling.

entities.name: NaH plus crown ether
observations: The closest exact-substrate precedent uses sodium hydride with a crown ether additive for N-sulfonylation of the N-H heteroarene.

entities.name: Alternative sulfonylation bases
observations: Plausible alternative bases are Cs2CO3, K2CO3, triethylamine, or DIPEA in a dry aprotic solvent.
